title: Kit RFC Requirement Registry Record
description: Machine-readable registry record for one atomic RFC 0001 normative statement, architectural promise, §36 decision, or §33 risk mitigation. See IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:83-134 and requirements/schema/README.md.

machineDecidableStatement.description: A single acceptance criterion or expected result. Banned vague words per IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md/plan.md §5 (robust, complete, appropriate, proper, sufficient, good, clean, reasonable, as needed) are rejected; the statement must instead name an exact command/check plus expected exit status, count, or digest.

id.description: Stable KIT-<AREA>-NNN identifier (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md completion contract #1). Never reused; the AREA token must equal `area` (enforced by scripts/req_lint.py, not decidable in-schema across two fields).

record_class.description: What kind of registry row this is: a normative RFC statement, a non-normative testable architectural promise (Phase 0 §4.2), an RFC §36 decision registered as an architecture assertion, or an RFC §33 risk registered as an evidence-bearing control.

modality.description: RFC 2119 keyword governing this record, or `declarative` for promises/decisions/risks that carry no normative keyword (Phase 0 §4.2: "testable declarative promises even when they lack normative keywords").

title.description: Short human-readable label for the atomic record.

atomic_text.description: The single atomic normative statement or declarative promise, split from compound prose or inherited lists per Phase 0 §4.1.

source_section.description: RFC.md section reference in §<n>[.<n>] form, optionally followed by the section title, e.g. `§36 Decisions`.

source_anchor.description: Exact RFC.md line or line range the record was extracted from.

source_quote.description: Verbatim quoted source text substantiating atomic_text.

source_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the stripped RFC text covered by source_anchor (the complete joined span for a range), used by CI to detect unregistered drift.

introduced_revision.description: Resolvable RFC.md git commit (short or full SHA-1) in which this requirement's cited RFC text was first introduced; this is RFC introduction history, not registry-row creation time.

status.description: Lifecycle state. `proposed`/`active` are live; `implemented` and `resolved_by_amendment` are the two terminal states counted toward architectural-promise resolution (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md T2); `not_selected` closes an optional mechanism; `tombstoned` retires a record (must carry tombstone_reason plus a replacement or decision record).

supersedes.description: id of the record this one replaces, when status is `tombstoned` and a replacement exists. Null otherwise.

tombstone_reason.description: Required non-null reason when status is `tombstoned`; must be null otherwise.

area.description: One of the 29 normalized KIT-<AREA> prefixes (trailing hyphen stripped) of IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:89-117.

applicability.description: Whether this record is unconditionally binding, an optional-mechanism disposition, or inapplicable to the current deployment scope. `mandatory` covers ordinary MUST/SHOULD requirements; `selected`/`not_selected`/`pending_voi` cover RFC §13/§16/§17/§29 optional mechanisms (Phase 0 completion contract #6); `not_applicable` requires a cited source per §9.3 rule 1.

interpretation.description: Operational reading of atomic_text: what must actually hold for this record to be satisfied.

acceptance_criteria.description: Numbered, machine-decidable criteria (exact command + expected exit status/count/digest). Banned vague words are rejected per-item.

primary_milestone.description: The single milestone (M001-M012) or PHASE0 that owns this record's closure.

contributing_milestones.description: Additional milestones that extend or depend on this record, beyond primary_milestone.

dependencies.description: ids of other registry records this record depends on.

owner.description: Accountable role/team for this record (e.g. "Governance owner", "Program owner", "Build owner", "Infra owner").

platforms.description: Platform cells this record applies to, per §9.2 of the wave plan.

deployment_tiers.description: Deployment modes this record applies to (Objective §1): local, restricted, clustered, hostile multi-tenant.

release_gates.description: Milestone gate(s) (G00-G12, optionally -CLUSTERED for the Wave 15 re-execution) this record's evidence feeds.

implementation_links.description: Paths to the implementation(s) satisfying this record (e.g. src/... files). May be empty before implementation lands.

public_contract_links.description: Paths/identifiers of the public contract surface this record binds (OpenAPI paths, CLI commands, protocol schemas). May be empty before the contract lands.

telemetry_links.description: Telemetry event/metric/dashboard identifiers sufficient to reproduce the acceptance result. May be empty for records with no telemetry obligation.

evidence_id.description: Canonical EV-<parent WP>-<C|E|O|M>-<NNN> form (plan.md §5); <parent WP> is either an M0NN-WNN[a-z] work package or, for n/a/gate-evidence units, a <wave>.<n> unit id.

evidence_job.description: CI lane name producing evidence for this record; the fixed 12-lane set of unit 1.13.

expected_result.description: Exact expected result of evidence_job (exit status, count, or digest). Banned vague words are rejected.

artifact_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the evidence-producing build artifact, recorded by the job. Null until the job has run.

environment_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the evidence-producing execution environment, recorded by the job. Null until the job has run.

versions.description: Pinned tool/dependency versions recorded by the evidence job (e.g. toolchain, agentkit commit). Null until the job has run.

latest_result.description: Outcome of the most recent evidence run. `outcome_unknown` mirrors the program invariant that every effect has a durable outcome or an explicit unknown (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §3.1); it is never silently treated as a pass.

revalidation_rule.description: Condition under which existing evidence goes stale and must be re-run (e.g. "on any change to source_quote's line range", "every release candidate").

decision_record.description: Path to the docs/decisions/DR-NNNN-<slug>.md record justifying an RFC-modality override, a not_selected disposition, or a tombstone without replacement. Null when no decision record governs this entry.

deviation_record.description: Free-text pointer to the documented exception evidencing a SHOULD/SHOULD NOT deviation (completion contract #5). Null when this record has no deviation.
